name: Hollow Grouper
tooltip:
Hollow Grouper
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Anglin' Score:  points.

Catch Rank: Guppy

Description:
A meaty, brutish, bottom feeder that inhabits the depths of Voidstorm's Oceanic Vortexes. Its large mouth allows it to exert minimal effort, sucking in inhabitants in a singular, large motion. Not the most intelligent creature, Hollow Groupers seem to bite at anything remotely resembling food.

Special:

Fresh Fillet

Salvaging this fish with the Cooking skill will produce Fresh Fillet.

Areas you can find this fish:
- Voidstorm

Fishing Pools:
- Oceanic Vortex
- Viscous Void

Rates:
- This fish is exceedingly common in pools.

Discovery: Fishing
